intro: APT33, CyberAv3ngers, and Interlock were the most active threat actors targeting critical infrastructure in a 22-article dataset from April 12 to May 14, 2026. The top vulnerability observed was CVE-2026-24032, rated CVSS 7.3. Affected sectors included energy, utilities, and manufacturing, primarily across the United States, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Of the 22 articles, 14 were classified as high severity, with three critical and one medium severity.
